meta.title: Rogue data sheet for WoW Forever (level 60, vs level 63 training dummy)
meta.scope: Every ability a level-60 rogue puts on its bars against a raid dummy, poisons, core combat rules, talents, default builds and stats, and the Combat Sinister Strike priority list.
meta.howToRead: Every number is an object {value, unit, source, confidence, note}. 'source' is a GitHub permalink (repo@commit/path#Lline) or a URL. 'confidence' is one of the three values in confidenceLegend.

confidenceLegend.confirmed-forever: Stated by the Forever beta client data (spell tables, talent curves, Wowhead Forever tooltips) or by Blizzard. Client data is not the same as an in-game measurement at level 60: beta access was level-capped for most testers, so level-60 numbers are datamined, not observed.
confidenceLegend.sim-provisional: A modelling choice of one or both sims that has no Forever source yet (or where the two sims disagree). Use it, but expect it to change.
confidenceLegend.classic-fallback: Forever data is silent, so the sims keep the Classic 1.12 / Classic Era value.

simsCompared.fs: laurencestokes/foreversim (branch 'master'), commit 255df1627f (2026-10-01). Engine: wowsims/forever + ElliotWood/Forever. Carries a generated store of the beta client spell rows (sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go).

level.note: Both sims assume a level 60 player.

comboPointsOnTarget.note: Points belong to the target; gaining points on a new target drops the old ones. Blizzard fixed (1 Oct) a bug where a missed Expose Armor dropped all combo points, so an avoided finisher keeps its points.

level.note: Boss = player level + 3 (defense skill 315 vs weapon skill 300).

armor.note: Classic boss armor used by foreversim's default target and by the user's dummy. gunba's test target uses 1104 (post-debuff).

target.mobTypeNote: Murder (+2/4%) only applies to Humanoid and Giant targets.
target.stunImmunityNote: Not modelled by the sims. Raid bosses are normally immune to stuns and incapacitates (Kidney Shot, Cheap Shot, Gouge); decide per dummy.

rogueGcd.note: Every rogue attack row has GCDMs 1000; Wowhead Forever shows 'Global cooldown: 1 second'.

affectedByHaste.note: Physical GCDs are fixed at 1.0 s in both sims (IgnoreHaste). Only spell GCDs scale with casting haste in gunba's model.

globalCooldown.offGcd: Cold Blood, Premeditation, Vanish, Stealth, Evasion, Sprint, Thistle Tea (client rows carry no GCD). Riposte has no GCDMs but sits in category 133 with a 1 s category cooldown.

vigor.note: Forever Vigor has 2 ranks (+5/+10). Not a regeneration bonus.

regenPerSecond.note: PowerType.db2: 10 energy/s in and out of combat.

gs.value: smooth: 1 energy every 100 ms (integration step, not a measured server tick)

evidence.value: Beta players describe modern continuous regeneration, not Classic ticks
evidence.note: No Blizzard statement found. Recommendation for the practice yard: continuous 10/s.

hasteScalesRegen.value: gs: general haste (haste stat, Skyborne Wind Blessed, haste Tier 1) multiplies regen; Slice and Dice, Blade Flurry and Berserking (attack speed only) do not. fs: no haste scaling.

adrenalineRush.note: Regen doubles to 20/s; both sims settle the partial interval at the old rate when it starts or ends.

builders.note: Refund on miss, dodge or parry. The client marks rogue attacks with attribute DISCOUNT_POWER_ON_MISS (Ex1 0x08000000) but stores no percentage; 80% is the inherited Classic/WotLK convention.

gs.note: gunba refunds nothing on an avoided finisher (Eviscerate, Rupture, Expose Armor).

fs.note: foreversim reads the same client bit, which is also set on Eviscerate, Rupture, Kidney Shot, Expose Armor and Venom, and refunds 80%.

thistleTea.note: Instant, 5 min item cooldown, Rogue and Druid. Off the GCD.

attackTable._note: Values vs a level 63 target with 300 weapon skill. Both sims implement the Classic table. In-game beta measurements (magey) agree with it except: hit suppression is gone, and glancing damage reduction is currently bugged in the beta.

weaponSkill.note: Forever removed weapon-skill racials; Human/Orc/Dwarf weapon racials give +2/+1/+1% crit instead.

source: https://github.com/magey/forever-warrior/issues/1 (community in-game attack table measurements on the Forever beta, 26 Sep - 10 Oct 2026)

sims.note: Both sims subtract 1% from gear hit vs +3 (Classic rule), so their special hit cap is 9%.

dualWieldWhiteMissPenalty.note: White swings only while dual wielding: 8% + 19% = 27% base miss vs +3 (28% in the sims with suppression). Not measured in Forever yet.

whiteTableOrder.value: miss > dodge > parry(front) > glancing > block(front) > crit > hit, single roll
whiteTableOrder.note: Crit is capped by what is left after miss, dodge and glancing (white crit cap).

specialTableOrder.value: miss (no DW penalty) > dodge > parry(front) > block(front); crit rolled separately on a hit
specialTableOrder.note: Two-roll specials are still an open question in the in-game tests.

spellMissForPoisons.note: Poisons roll the spell table: 17% base miss vs +3, reduced by hit (gear hit and Precision both count in Forever), floor 1%.

parryHaste.source: https://github.com/magey/forever-warrior/issues/1 (community in-game attack table measurements on the Forever beta, 26 Sep - 10 Oct 2026)
parryHaste.note: Irrelevant against a dummy that does not attack.

unifiedGearHitCrit.note: Hit and crit on gear count for melee, ranged and spells (poisons). Attribute conversions unchanged.

critPerAgility.note: 0.0345% per agility (29 agility = 1%). Rogue base melee crit 0%.

weaponRacialCrit.unit: % crit while a matching weapon is held
weaponRacialCrit.note: Pays to attacks and spells; not doubled by two matching weapons.

source: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24310968 (Blizzard, Rogue and Warlock class deep dive, 2026-10-07)
malicePrecisionCoverPoisons.note: Malice adds spell crit and Precision adds spell hit too.

hitAndCrit.poisonCritChance: Spell crit only: Malice + gear crit (unified) + buffs. Agility gives no spell crit. Poison crits deal 150%.

lethality.unit: added to the crit damage bonus per rank
lethality.note: 5/5 makes a special crit 2.2x (Classic was 6%/rank, 2.3x). Applies to Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate (both hits), Ghostly Strike, Hemorrhage. Not Eviscerate, Ambush.

formula.value: damage multiplier = 1 - A / (A + 400 + 85 x attackerLevel) = 1 - A / (A + 5500) at level 60

exampleAt3731.note: 3731/(3731+5500). Derived; with 5-point Expose Armor (3731-2250=1481) mitigation is 0.2122.

armor.armorIgnorePercent: Applied before the formula: Serrated Blades 3/6/9%, Hack and Slash mace 3..15%.

bleedsIgnoreArmor.note: Rupture and Garrote ticks ignore armor.

exposeVsSunder.value: Expose Armor (450/CP, 2250 at 5) and Sunder Armor (450/stack, 2250 at 5) do not stack: only the strongest applies. In Forever Expose Armor no longer prevents casting Sunder.
source: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24310968 (Blizzard, Rogue and Warlock class deep dive, 2026-10-07)

autoAttack.value: roll(min..max) + AP/14 x weaponSpeed; off-hand x 0.5 x (1 + Dual Wield Specialization)

normalizedSpeeds.note: Used by normalized specials: Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Hemorrhage, Mutilate.

source: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24310968 (Blizzard, Rogue and Warlock class deep dive, 2026-10-07)
dualWieldSpecialization.note: Halved from Classic's 10%/rank (Blizzard: 'Increase to off-hand damage reduced'). Off hand at 5/5 = 0.5 x 1.25 = 62.5%.

dotsCanCrit.note: Rupture, Garrote and Deadly Poison V rows carry PERIODIC_CAN_CRIT. Bleeds crit for 2.0x, poison ticks for 1.5x.

dynamicTicks.note: Each tick re-reads attack power and damage modifiers; combo points spent and the Hemorrhage bonus stay as cast.

sliceAndDice.note: Multiplies swing speed (x1.3). Does not change energy regen or the GCD.

bladeFlurry.note: x1.2, stacks multiplicatively with Slice and Dice (x1.56). The cleave copy only matters with 2+ targets.

poisonsAndTemporaryEnchants.value: Poisons occupy their own slot: a weapon can carry a poison and a sharpening stone / oil at the same time; Windfury Totem also coexists.

priority.when: (CP >= 1 AND Slice and Dice not active AND fight time left >= 6 s) OR (CP >= 5 AND Slice and Dice remaining < 3 s AND fight time left > 9 s)
energy < 59 AND time to next energy tick < 1 s (with continuous regen: energy < 59)

priority.ability: other ready cooldowns (Blade Flurry, Cold Blood, trinkets, racials)

priority.when: CP >= 5 AND (Slice and Dice active OR energy >= 79 OR fight time left < 6 s)

backstab.priority: same as 'simple' with Backstab (25300) instead of Sinister Strike

priority: Cold Blood if CP >= 4 and SnD active
mutilate_gs.note: Neither sim's Mutilate APL casts Venom.

priority: Slice and Dice if CP >= 1, SnD down, >= 6 s left
Vanish if not stealthed, energy >= 60, CP <= 1, SnD up, >= 10 s left
Slice and Dice if CP >= 5 and SnD <= 2 s
Hemorrhage if own Hemorrhage debuff down, CP >= 2, Rupture down, >= 10 s left
Rupture if CP >= 3, Rupture down, >= 10 s left

foreverVsClassic.change: Energy regenerates continuously (10/s) instead of 20 every 2 s
Dots and bleeds can crit; ticks use current AP and modifiers
Gear hit/crit count for attacks and spells (poisons); Malice and Precision cover poisons
source: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24310968 (Blizzard, Rogue and Warlock class deep dive, 2026-10-07)

foreverVsClassic.change: Hit suppression vs +3 is gone (special cap 8%, sims still use 9%)
source: https://github.com/magey/forever-warrior/issues/1 (community in-game attack table measurements on the Forever beta, 26 Sep - 10 Oct 2026)

foreverVsClassic.change: Weapon-skill racials replaced by crit (Human sword +2%, Orc axe +1%, Dwarf mace +1%); rogues can use one-handed axes
source: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24310968 (Blizzard, Rogue and Warlock class deep dive, 2026-10-07)

foreverVsClassic.change: Poisons: about one third less damage, more charges, separate from stones/oils, tiny AP scaling (0.5% / 0.45%)
source: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24310968 (Blizzard, Rogue and Warlock class deep dive, 2026-10-07)

foreverVsClassic.change: Expose Armor 450/CP (2250), no longer blocks Sunder; Improved Expose Armor now cost and CP refund
source: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24310968 (Blizzard, Rogue and Warlock class deep dive, 2026-10-07)

foreverVsClassic.change: Hemorrhage: one rank, normalized, 145% with dagger, personal +15% Rupture debuff instead of raid debuff
Ghostly Strike 180% with a main-hand dagger
New: Mutilate (4 ranks), Venom, Flawless Execution, Hack and Slash, Puncturing Wounds, Quietus, Cutthroat, Thousand Cuts, Remorseless Attacks moved, Coup de Grace passive (client)
Lethality 4%/rank (20%), Dual Wield Specialization 5%/rank (25%), Deflection 2%/rank, Vigor 2 ranks, Initiative/Setup 33/67/100%, Premeditation window 20 s, Weapon Expertise now -dodge/parry
source: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24310968 (Blizzard, Rogue and Warlock class deep dive, 2026-10-07)

foreverVsClassic.change: Aggression also boosts Backstab; Opportunity covers Garrote and Mutilate
source: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24310968 (Blizzard, Rogue and Warlock class deep dive, 2026-10-07)

foreverVsClassic.change: Feint threat reduction raised (client 5x, Blizzard text 'doubled'); Sap no longer breaks Stealth
source: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24310968 (Blizzard, Rogue and Warlock class deep dive, 2026-10-07)

foreverVsClassic.change: Backstab tooltip reads '150% weapon damage plus 150' (Era: plus 225) - meaning unresolved
Glancing damage vs +3 currently ~75% in the beta (intended 65%, reported as bug)
source: https://github.com/magey/forever-warrior/issues/1 (community in-game attack table measurements on the Forever beta, 26 Sep - 10 Oct 2026)

openQuestions: Energy delivery: continuous (gs, player reports) vs 2 s ticks (fs). No Blizzard statement.
Does general haste raise energy regen? (CORE-002)
Refund on avoided attacks: 80% assumed for builders; finishers 0% (gs) vs 80% (fs). (CORE-003)
Backstab flat bonus: x1.5 (sims, 225) or plain 150 (Forever tooltip)?
AP coefficients of Eviscerate (3%/CP), Rupture and Garrote are Classic's; the client has none.
Deadly Poison 0.45% AP: per tick or per stack? Not in either sim. Instant Poison 0.5% only in gs.
Hit cap: in-game data says 8% special (no suppression); both sims model 9%. Dual-wield white penalty (19%) not measured.
Glancing damage vs +3: beta shows ~25% reduction (bug?), sims use 35% (55-75%).
Are specials still two-roll for crit in Forever?
Availability at 60 of AQ-era ranks: Backstab 9 (25300), Eviscerate 9 (31016), Deadly Poison V (25347).
Coup de Grace (1310709) passive: is it learned, and how does it work? Not in sims.
Mutilate off-hand: is the flat 67 also halved? (ROG-001)
Venom on an already-ticking Deadly Poison. (Open in beta-pass)
Hack and Slash with mixed weapons (dagger + sword etc.). (ROG-005)
Blade Flurry copied damage modifiers (only matters with 2+ targets). (ROG-007)
Relentless Strikes 20%/CP and Ruthlessness 20%/rank kept from Classic/demo; client curves not read.
